subject: Exploring micro-bundles & entitlements for Arkwell — sizing + pricing
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@arkwell.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Niles <sophie.n@arkwell.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring micro-bundles & entitlements for Arkwell — sizing + pricing

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Arkwell's eng/product teams liked the latency profile and the KV caching examples. We're now discussing packaging options internally and I wanted to get a clearer picture of how Redwood handles smaller, scoped bundles of features. A few specific asks:

- Can you outline an entry-level micro-bundle that would make sense for our pilot (10–25 inference instances, mostly short-chat traffic)?
- How are entitlements defined — per-seat, per-route, or per-feature flag? We want to gate a few premium ops (advanced reranking, long-context support) behind a bundle add-on.
- Do you offer mid-term step-ups (e.g., upgrade from micro-bundle to standard tier) without penalty / pro-rata credits?
- Any sample pricing ranges or discount thresholds for a 12-month pilot vs. 24-month commitment?

We're trying to compare a small committed package vs. pure hosted usage and want to evaluate cost certainty vs. flexibility. If helpful I can share approximate token volumes and peak QPS.

Would love a short pricing sketch this week — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Oliver
Director of Product
Arkwell Health

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@arkwell.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring micro-bundles & entitlements for Arkwell — sizing + pricing

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate you sharing the pilot sizing direction; that helps. Quick answers up front and then I’ll loop in Priyom for concrete SKU-level numbers:

- Micro-bundle concept: yes — we can create a constrained bundle that contains a baseline inference tier (shared hosted capacity with priority lanes) + a feature add-on pack that gates advanced reranking and long-context KV support. The baseline is priced to be attractive for pilots; add-ons are toggled as entitlements.
- Entitlements model: we typically do feature entitlements as billed add-ons per "route" plus a small per-seat registration fee when seat-based admin features are required. For Arkwell’s use case (pilot with few seats, many routes), per-route add-ons are usually simpler.
- Step-ups: we support pro-rata credits and a transparent upgrade path — you can apply unused commit toward the new tier; there’s no long-term penalty for moving up.
- Commitment vs hosted: 12-month pilots usually clear at a modest 10–15% discount vs pay-as-you-go; 24-months moves to ~18–25% depending on commit size and reserved capacity needs. Priyom will drop concrete ranges and a sample SKU sheet.

I’ve attached a short draft MAAs and will ask Priyom to propose 2-3 compact bundles (light, standard, scale) and one flexible step-up flow. Can we pencil a 30-min call Wed 9/16 to walk through options? I’ve included a Calendly link below.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: MAA_Draft.pdf (7 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring micro-bundles & entitlements for Arkwell — sizing + pricing

Hi Oliver — great to meet you over email. Per Jasmine’s note, I put together three compact bundle options and included the proposed SKU sheet (attached). High level:

Option A — Pilot Micro (recommended for 10–25 inference instances):
- Baseline: Shared hosted inference with 50k tokens/mo included, streaming enabled
- Entitlements: Per-route advanced reranking (up to 2 routes included), KV long-context add-on (single model slot)
- Billing: Monthly invoice, 10% discount vs pay-as-you-go if 12-month commit; 16% if 24-month commit

Option B — Micro + Seats (pilot + admin):
- Baseline + per-seat admin features (SSO, elevated console seats up to 5)
- Entitlements as above but with 2 additional route slots
- Billing: Quarterly invoicing, 12% discount at 12 months; 20% at 24 months. Includes 1 migration credit to Dedicated for a canary test.

Option C — Elastic Micro (flex upgrade path):
- Lower baseline commit, higher overage ratio but includes automated step-up credits: 50% of unused commit applies toward next tier within first 9 months
- Good if you expect uneven load and want cheaper entry without lock-in

Key mechanics and negotiables:
- Entitlements are implemented as route-level flags; we can create custom "feature packs" for Arkwell to gate reranker/KV per route.
- Pro-rata upgrades: unused months in commit are applied as credits toward the new commitment on a straight-line basis. No early-exit penalties for upgrades.
- Discount floors: for pilots under $25k ARR equivalent, discounts are capped as above unless a platform credit is negotiated.

Attached: Proposed_SKUs.xlsx (12 KB) — contains example SKUs and sample monthly invoice math for 10/20/25 instance profiles.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm which entitlements you want in pilot (reranking, KV, long-context etc.).
2) Pick Option A/B/C or request a hybrid.
3) If we agree, I’ll send a short term sheet + pricing table and Jasmine will schedule the Wed 9/16 call to finalize.

If you want a 12-month firm price for Option B (includes seats), we can lock a rate today pending signature — request please and I’ll produce the short sheet.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Pricing & Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachment: Proposed_SKUs.xlsx

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@arkwell.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring micro-bundles & entitlements for Arkwell — sizing + pricing

Jasmine / Priyom — thanks, this is very helpful. Sophie and I reviewed the SKU sheet and we like Option B as the baseline (pilot + admin seats). A few clarifying asks before Wed’s call: 

- Can you produce a firm 12-month price for Option B including the 12% discount and the migration credit called out? We’re ready to sign if the monthly run-rate stays within a ~10% variance of the modeled numbers in Proposed_SKUs.xlsx.
- For the entitlements, we’ll take reranking on 3 routes (one extra than your standard), and KV long-context on the pilot model slot. Are there any technical limits to adding a third route?
- SLA question: is 99.9% part of the pilot or only at Dedicated/reserved capacity?

If you can push the 12-month term sheet before EoD Thursday, Sophie and I will route for internal approval and we can sign next week.

Appreciate the clarity — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Oliver
